g.text: CommitGate Authority V2 — Product Trust Topology
Only the Transition Worker can mutate authoritative state; every other component receives the minimum capability it needs.
Linux Docker · serial per Agent · filesystem
API: Authority RO · Control RO · no socket · no key
Worker: Authority RW · Control RW · Exchange RW
Broker: Exchange RW · Docker socket RW · no key
Relay: Provider secret only · no workspace
Agent: candidate subpath RW · relay capability
Verifier: proposal subpath RO · network none
Claim boundary: no power-loss/fsync guarantee · no hostile host/root isolation · no arbitrary external-effect rollback · no semantic-correctness proof
One immutable proposal + complete trusted evidence + one-shot permit = one authoritative transition
Replay rule: a consumed permit stays consumed after API/Worker restart. Replaying K1 returns PERMIT_REPLAY and cannot change HEAD.
